ops.title: Fixes-pack teammate denylist: regex → structural command parsing (cc-sudo false positive)
ops.body:
## What & why (CHANGELOG 9.27.0, 2026-07-17)

The fixes-pack skip-permissions approvers (`teammate_permissions.py`) auto-approve a subagent's Bash/MCP command in `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` sessions unless a denylist matches. The denylist was a regex `DANGEROUS_COMMAND` whose `\b(rm|dd|shred|truncate|sudo|mkfs[.\w]*)\b` alternative matched the substring `sudo` inside the repo name **`cc-sudo`** (a hyphen is a regex word boundary). Any fleet command that merely listed/greped/looped over `cc-sudo` was read as a destructive `sudo` invocation → denied auto-approval → spurious permission dialog. Confirmed live: 4 of a session's 69 subagent Bash calls (all `cc-sudo` fleet enumerations) failed auto-approval on exactly this.

Per the user's directive ("stop using regexes for this, use the command-parsing primitives we have"), both approvers now parse the command via `cc_transcript.command` (tree-sitter, surfaced as `evt.command_line`) and flag a destructive program only in **command position** — a repo/path name is an argument token, never the executable, so the whole false-positive class disappears structurally.

## Design (`captain_hook/packs/fixes/_lib.py`)

- `is_dangerous_command_line(cl, depth=3)` — per-command: `sudo` on raw executable; unwrapped executable in `{rm,dd,shred,truncate}` or `mkfs*`; dangerous `git` (subcommand walker skipping global value-flags like `-C`/`-c`/`--git-dir` → `reset`/`clean`/`restore`, or `push` with `--?force(-with-lease)?|-f|--delete` incl. `=value` form); downloader (`curl`/`wget`) piped (`next_op=="|"`) into a shell; and a `sh -c '<cmd>'` / `eval '<cmd>'` payload re-parsed to bounded depth.
- `DangerousCommandLine(CustomCommandLineCondition)` — native Bash (approver #1). `DangerousPayloadCommand(CustomCondition)` — MCP payloads via `command_texts` (8KB cap), approver #2.
- `unwrap_argv` — basename-aware wrapper strip (fixes `/usr/bin/env bash`), else parity with `Command.unwrapped`.
- `normalize_executable`/`unescape_shell` PROMOTED from `packs/general/deletions.py` to `captain_hook/util/shell.py`, shared by the rm-guard and fixes pack (one primitive, no cross-pack import).
- `DANGEROUS_COMMAND` regex and `PayloadText` condition DELETED.

## Review (2 codex-sol xhigh finders + opus parity + 2 codex-sol refuter rounds)

First pass found **4 regressions + 1 crash the swap introduced** (all fixed): `--force-with-lease=<val>` valued form (→ `(=.*)?`); `bash -c`/`eval` payloads uninspected (→ bounded recursion, `NESTED_COMMAND_DEPTH=3`); lone-surrogate MCP payload crashed `parse_command_line` (→ `errors="replace"` sanitize); deeply-nested input `RecursionError` in tree-sitter `walk_node` (→ `safe_parse_command_line` try/except, falls open). A `timeout 5s` duration-skip was tried then REVERTED — it caused `env 5s`/`timeout 5s 6s` false positives; bare-int skip (dependency parity) restored, `timeout 5s <destructive>` accepted as tolerated FN. Final refuter: ALL DELTAS SOUND, no new FP/crash.

**Accepted tolerated false negatives (documented, NOT regressions — old regex missed them too or pure evasions):** `env sudo X`, `curl |& sh`, `git r\eset`, `find -exec rm`, `ssh host rm`, `bash /dev/null -c`, `git push -- --force=refspec` (pre-existing), 8KB-boundary split (old code capped identically), shlex-quoted multi-level nesting.

## State
- 89 inline approver+rm-guard tests + full pytest green; ruff clean. No public-API/docs impact (all symbols pack-internal or already re-exported).
- Committed scoped to my 5 files (excluded a FOREIGN working-tree change to `primitives/commands.py` — another session's `rewrite_command_occurrences` callable-block work).
- **Release: v9.26.0 is committed-but-untagged (concurrent release in flight from another session); tag/release version decision surfaced to the user rather than auto-tagged.**
- OUT OF SCOPE (recorded, not acted on): two other sessions ran hookless because CC dropped the git-source plugin at startup (cache miss / partial snapshot) — a CC-side bug; issue draft at /tmp/cc-hookloss-issue.md, NOT posted (user decision).
